info.name: Users
info.description:
User management endpoints including profile management and session management.

All endpoints include:
- **Rate limiting** protection
- **Audit logging** of user events
- **Token versioning** validation
- **Session management** (list, revoke specific, revoke all)

request.description:
**Create a new user account (Admin Only)**

Only admins can create users. Password must meet security requirements.

**Password Requirements:**
- Minimum 12 characters
- At least one uppercase letter
- At least one lowercase letter
- At least one number
- At least one special character

**TOTP Setup (MANDATORY):**
- TOTP is automatically set up for all new users
- Response includes:
  - `totpSetup.qrCodeUrl`: Base64-encoded QR code image (display to user)
  - `totpSetup.secret`: TOTP secret for manual entry (if QR code cannot be scanned)
  - `totpSetup.backupCodes`: Array of 10 backup codes (user MUST save these securely)

**⚠️ IMPORTANT:**
- User must scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
- User must save backup codes in a secure location
- User cannot login until TOTP is verified

**Audit Logging:**
- User creation logged as `USER_CREATED`
- Includes creator ID, new user ID, and user information

**Response:**
- `user`: Created user information
- `totpSetup`: TOTP setup information (QR code, secret, backup codes)

**List all users with pagination (Admin Only)**

Only admins can access this endpoint.

**Query Parameters:**
- `page`: Page number (default: 1)
- `limit`: Items per page (default: 50)
- `search`: Search by email or name (optional)

**Rate Limiting:**
- General API rate limit applies: 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP
- Check `RateLimit-*` headers in response

**Response:**
- `users`: Array of user objects
- `pagination`: Pagination information (page, limit, total, totalPages)

request.description:
**Get current authenticated user's profile**

Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

**Token Versioning:**
- This endpoint validates token version
- If password was changed, token version increments
- Old tokens become invalid and return 401 with message: "Token has been invalidated. Please login again."
- This prevents token reuse after password compromise

**Rate Limiting:**
- General API rate limit applies: 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP
- Check `RateLimit-*` headers in response

**Response:**
- User profile information including:
  - `id`, `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `avatarUrl`
  - `role`, `storageQuota`, `storageUsed`
  - `emailVerified`, `totpEnabled`, `totpVerified`
  - `createdAt`, `updatedAt`

**Get storage usage analytics**

Returns detailed storage usage breakdown by file type for the current user.

**Response:**
- `totalUsed`: Total storage used in bytes
- `totalQuota`: Total storage quota in bytes
- `usageByType`: Breakdown by file type (images, videos, audio, documents, archives, others)

request.description:
**Update current user's profile with avatar upload**

Update the current authenticated user's profile information and optionally upload a new avatar image.

**Request Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Form Fields:**
- `avatar` (file, optional): Avatar image file
  - **Allowed formats:** JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP
  - **Max size:** 5MB
  - **Storage:** Uploaded to OCI Object Storage bucket under `avatars/{userId}/`
  - **URL:** 7-day presigned URL returned
- `firstName` (text, optional): User's first name
- `lastName` (text, optional): User's last name

**How to Test:**
1. Click on the `avatar` field in Body > form-data
2. Click 'Select Files' and choose an image from your computer
3. Optionally update firstName and lastName fields
4. Send the request

**Avatar Storage:**
- Avatar is uploaded to OCI Object Storage
- Old avatar is automatically deleted when new one is uploaded
- A presigned URL (valid for 7 days) is generated and stored in user profile
- Avatar path: `avatars/{userId}/{timestamp}-{filename}`

**Token Versioning:**
- Token version is validated before allowing update
- If token is invalid (password changed), returns 401

**Rate Limiting:**
- General API rate limit applies: 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP
- Check `RateLimit-*` headers in response

**Response:**
- `id`: User ID
- `email`: User email
- `firstName`: Updated first name
- `lastName`: Updated last name
- `avatarUrl`: Presigned URL to the uploaded avatar (valid for 7 days)
- `updatedAt`: Timestamp of the update

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "user-id",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "firstName": "Updated",
    "lastName": "Name",
    "avatarUrl": "https://objectstorage.region.oci.customer-oci.com/p/{presigned-token}/...",
    "updatedAt": "2026-01-20T18:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "message": "Profile updated successfully"
}
```

**⚠️ NOTES:**
- All fields are optional - you can update just the avatar, just the name, or both
- If you don't select an avatar file, only text fields will be updated
- Presigned URLs expire after 7 days - frontend should handle renewal

**List all active sessions**

Returns a list of all active sessions for the current user, including session ID, device info, location, and timestamps.

request.description:
**Revoke a specific session**

Logs out the device associated with the given session ID.

**Revoke all other sessions**

Logs out all devices except the current one.
